description: This file defines a trait 'LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait' providing helper methods for handling leave request parameters within an API context. It includes methods to retrieve and validate leave-related request parameters such as leave type, dates, comments, and durations, and constructs a LeaveParameterObject based on these inputs.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type ID parameter from the request body as an integer.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from date' parameter from the request body as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to date' parameter from the request body as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getCommentParam
methods.description: Retrieves the comment parameter from the request body as a string or null.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Retrieves a duration array parameter from the request body given a key, or null.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Retrieves the partial option parameter from the request body as a string or null.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestParams
methods.description: Constructs and returns a LeaveParameterObject based on request parameters, potentially setting multi-day or single-day durations.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOptions
methods.description: Sets partial options and durations for multi-day leave requests.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets a single day duration in the LeaveParameterObject based on request parameters.

methods.name: getGeneratedDuration
methods.description: Creates a LeaveDuration object from request data, or returns null if insufficient data.

methods.name: getCommonParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of validation rules for leave request parameters.
